item.title: Self-Hosted Audio Processing Libraries: PortAudio vs miniaudio vs OpenAL Soft vs libsoundio in 2026
item.description: Cross-platform audio I/O is one of the most challenging aspects of multimedia application development. Unlike file I/O or network sockets, audio requires strict real-time guarantees — a buffer underrun means an audible glitch that users immediately notice. Whether you’re building a VoIP client, a DAW plugin, a game engine, or a self-hosted streaming service, choosing the right audio backend library shapes your architecture for years.
